participation.context: Ruled the line, wrote the page, and stopped where that page stops.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote the account as the figures stand, the three nights as not received, and the wood-play as unfinished. You left the bottom of the coffer off the leaf, and you left any reason for money held back off it too.

title: Wrote the year's account on one leaf

participation.context: Wrote the facing leaf and set the pen down.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You set down owed, made, the list, and the note under Words. You did not turn the list into a column, and you did not give the twenty pounds a reason.

title: Wrote the facing leaf and stopped

participation.context: Laid it down and did not write in it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You set the unmarked almanac on the used one. You did not fill a day, and you did not open a new account book.

title: Laid the new almanac on the old

participation.context: Said the sum, refused the page, and stopped.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You spoke the twenty pounds and did not write them. You did not say why. You stopped on not done.

participation.context: Wrote the line, set the pen down, and did not continue.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You began again after the count, with one line and a blank. You did not make an ending.

title: Wrote one line on the twelfth leaf

story.body: You had the locked box and the unfinished pages in the same candle. You did not open the box again.

title: Looked at the coffer beside the leaves
